description: This file contains a test suite that verifies the behavior of a custom reporter class in a Playwright testing environment. It defines a Reporter class with an onEnd method, and a test that ensures the reporter does not cause the test run to fail even if it does not override the exit code properly.

classes.name: Reporter
classes.description: A custom reporter class with an asynchronous onEnd method that returns a simple status object.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: An asynchronous method that returns a Promise resolving to an object indicating the test status.
